text:
Aisha (PM): Quick async check — Q2 OKR milestone status across pillars. Please reply with 1) shipped/slipped, 2) owner, 3) main dependency or blocker, 4) next action. We're aiming to capture anything that affects the mid-quarter review.

Ben (Eng): Serving runtime: Canary deploy for runtime-v2 went out yesterday. Throughput looks good on p50/p95, but we saw a memory regression on long sequences in the simulator. Shipped -> partial. Owner: Ben. Blocker: reproducer + perf trace needed from eng-sre. Next action: open a short bug + attach perf trace; PR #4217 pinned for hotfix.

Carlos (Eng-Platform): Dedicated autoscale policy (RB-2) is slipping ~2 weeks. Load tests uncovered a race when scaling down multiple pods; root cause is GRPC connection teardown ordering. Owner: Carlos. Dependency: eng-sre can't reproduce locally; need infra test harness update from infra team. Next: I'll submit a test-only patch and drop a run link here by EOD Monday. @Ben please flag if the hotfix for runtime affects autoscale tests.

Dana (Eng-ML): Model onboarding: two models validated and in staging (m-ada-v3, m-tt-lite). Quantization job for m-tt-lite failed final accuracy check (~1.8% loss on our eval set). Shipped -> staging; slipped -> quantization. Owner: Dana. Blocker: eval thresholds + need an updated calibration script. Next action: rolling back quantization profile and re-run; PR #4320 for calibration updates, requesting review from @Ben and @Carlos.

Elena (Product Ops): Console observability tweaks (per-route latency breakdown) rolled out to internal canary. Shipped. Owner: Elena. Dependency: needs schema change in telemetry pipeline (minor). Next: ops will coordinate with eng-infra to flip the flag next week.

Ben (Eng): @Dana seeing PR #4320 now. I can review tomorrow morning. Also adding a link to the heap trace we got: https://gist.github.com/redwood/serving-heap-1766 — that should help root cause. :mag:

Carlos (Eng-Platform): Adding timeline: autoscale harness patch created: https://ci.redwood/integration/patch/998 — test run scheduled. If green, we recover timeline to on-time; if not, expect +2 weeks. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Dana (Eng-ML): Re: quantization, I've attached a minimal repro and the failing eval set snippet in the PR. If we can't meet the eval threshold, product asked to consider a smaller model fallback in traffic routing. @Aisha want to weigh in?

Aisha (PM): Good call. For fallback routing we need a short runbook and owner — propose @Ben own routing change (short-lived) and @Elena own messaging/telemetry. If quantization not fixed by Thu, extra step: canary traffic split to fallback (10%) until accuracy validated. Agree?

Elena (Product Ops): Agreed. I'll draft the runbook and create a small doc in Confluence, link here once done. Also tagging support to prep a blameless note for customers: #support-ops.

Ben (Eng): OK I'll prep the routing PR and add tests. PR draft: https://git.redwood/dev/routing/PR-189 — please add quick review if you can.

Carlos (Eng-Platform): Quick note on priority: autoscale is blocking capacity guarantees for Dedicated customers — marking it P0 for the next two sprints. If anyone needs the capacity, ping me and I'll re-prioritize tests.

Jenkins (bot): deploy/serving-runtime-v2 canary -> success (1766000120)

Dana (Eng-ML): Small ask: can we get one extra GPU node in staging for longer eval runs? Owner: @Eng-Infra. @Carlos can you help request? It'll speed up quantization cycles.

Carlos (Eng-Platform): I'll open the infra ticket and link here. Ticket: INFRA-7241. ETA to provision: 24-48h.

Ben (Eng): Quick CR ping: @everyone please review PR #4217 (hotfix for memory regression) and #189 (routing PR). Two approvals gets the hotfix to canary rollback/fix. Thanks. :pray:

Aisha (PM): Summary for mid-quarter: shipped -> console observability; partial ship -> runtime-v2 canary (hotfix in progress); slipped -> autoscale (2w risk) and quantization (depends on calibration). Owners: Ben (runtime + fallback routing), Carlos (autoscale + infra ticket), Dana (quantization), Elena (console + runbook). Blockers tracked: INFRA-7241, PRs #4217, #4320, #189. Next steps: owners update this thread with green/red by Mon EOD and link PR/test runs. If red, escalate to Monday standup for plan B.

Elena (Product Ops): I'll update the OKR doc after you all confirm. Thanks for quick replies — helpful for the review pack. :white_check_mark:

Ben (Eng): Marking action items in the tracker now. pinging @eng-sre for perf trace follow-up.

Carlos (Eng-Platform): Test run started (integration/harness/998) — I'll post outcomes here. :rocket:

Dana (Eng-ML): Will re-run quantization after infra node is provisioned. ETA Wednesday.

Aisha (PM): Thanks everyone. If anyone hits a blocker that changes customer-facing dates, call it out immediately. Otherwise we'll close this capture on Mon and roll into the mid-quarter review doc.
